about.projectSectionText: This app is a fully personal project with no commercial purpose. Its source code is openly available on GitHub.
bugsSectionBullets: Page audio will be added; audio also needs to be generated for the shorter surahs on the page in juz 30
creditsSectionBullets: Verse Shazam · FastConformer: "fastconformer-quran-ar" by mohammed (huggingface.co/mohammed/fastconformer-quran-ar). Based on NVIDIA NeMo FastConformer, trained on tarteel-ai/everyayah. License: CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0). Used without modification.
Verse Shazam · Whisper: "whisper-base-ar-quran" by Tarteel AI (huggingface.co/tarteel-ai/whisper-base-ar-quran). License: Apache 2.0.

bullets: Added a Duas screen to the Prayers and Duas menu: read ready-made duas in the verse view (Arabic, transliteration and meaning), starting with the Laylat al-Qadr Qunut Dua with its recording; the part and the word being recited are followed word by word as it plays, like the verses
Under the "Asaynâke fe emheltenâ" part of the Qunut Dua, a link to "İsyan ve Kayboluş", an essay on that part (in Turkish)
Every tasbihat now has its Arabic text; switch between Arabic and transliteration with the toggle at the top
Küçük Tesbihat now has audio: from Fâ'lem ennehû on, play Ömer Arslan's recitation and the screen follows along, counting the 33 tawhid by itself
You can slow down or speed up the Küçük Tesbihat audio, from 0.75x to 2x
In Küçük Tesbihat, the salawat's text switches to end with "kesîran kesîrâ" for its third reading
In the dhikr counter you couldn't go back after moving to the next step; "Previous" now takes you back to the start of the previous step, and "Undo" only takes back the last count
"Reset" first clears the current step's count, and a second press starts the whole tasbihat over
Writing your own dhikr by voice now works on the web too: the Verse Shazam speech model types what you recite into the text field
On the web, reloading a page reset the address to the home page, so a second reload opened the home page; you now stay on the page you reloaded

Added reminders for holy nights, bayrams and blessed days: Regaib, Mi'raj, Berat, Mawlid, Laylat al-Qadr, bayrams and their eves. Turn them on or off in Prayer Time Settings and choose which days and how many days ahead to be reminded
The Hijri calendar showed some holy nights and bayrams a day late; fixed to match Diyanet's calendar, and Regaib Night is now marked too
Added a dhikr counter: from the Prayers and Duas menu, count the post-prayer tasbihat, Küçük Tesbihat and 100/500/1000 dhikr, set a target, and add your own dhikr by typing (or by voice on Android)
Topic search is now in the Android app too: open it from the Search menu and, after a one-time model download, it runs on your device
Fixed the app repeatedly showing "keeps stopping" in the background while the ongoing prayer times notification is on
See the reports you've sent and their status, or create a new one, under "My Bug Reports" on the profile page
Resolved reports now show a note on what was fixed; tap links in the note to open them
With verse tracking on, the screen now moves to the next surah along with the recitation and keeps following the playing verse
Verse tracking now turns on automatically when you start playing a verse
Shaking the phone 2-3 times is now enough to open the bug report screen, and a light vibration lets you know it opened
Added bug reporting: shake your phone for a few seconds or tap the bug icon at the top
Added a "Buy Me a Zamzam" link to the About page to support the developer
Word translations on hover now work on Android and mobile web too: tap a word for its translation, tap again for its root
Fixed the download percentage going past 100% on web while downloading translation data, and a stray "0" at the end of the status text
Shortened the descriptions in prayer time settings and removed unnecessary ones
Fixed the download screen coming back after downloading the translation data on first launch; no app restart needed anymore.
If a data update from Settings fails midway, your existing data is no longer wiped; if no data is left, the download screen now shows correctly.
Fixed the previous verse flashing for a moment when swiping in paged view; jumping to a distant verse no longer shows another verse in between.
Fixed the reciter picker opened from the header menu on narrow screens: taps no longer pass through to the buttons behind it, so you can pick a reciter again.
Added a 1x1 "Prayer countdown" home screen widget: shows the next prayer and the time left, tap to open the prayer times.
New widgets: "Prayer times" with the six times and the countdown, "Verse" with the Arabic and its translation, and "Prayer times and verse" combining both.
The verse widget can show a new verse at each prayer time or on tap, or a fixed verse you pick in Settings > Widgets.
Widget text grows and shrinks with the widget's size.
Added missed prayer tracking: notifications have "Prayed" / "Not prayed" buttons; a prayer you answer "Not prayed" goes on your list and you're reminded the next day at the same time.
Each prayer can have its own alert sound: default, vibrate, silent or one of your own sounds added under "My sounds"; you can play the sounds you add to hear them.
The persistent notification shows "Makruh time" during the makruh periods (per Diyanet: ~45 min after sunrise, ~10 min before Dhuhr, ~45 min before Maghrib).
On Fridays, when the Friday prayer reminder falls at the same time as a Dhuhr reminder, only the Friday one is shown.
Added a Friday prayer reminder to Prayer Time Settings: on Fridays you get a reminder 60 minutes before Dhuhr (adjustable).
Suhoor and iftar alerts now come on their own in Ramadan; turn on "Fasting mode" when you fast outside Ramadan.
When the app opens, it tells you if newer translations and word meanings are available; tap "Download" to update right away.

Added prayer time alerts: get notified when each prayer time begins and, if you like, 5–60 minutes before. Notifications and travel mode are on a new Prayer Time Settings page, opened from Settings or the settings icon on the Prayer Times screen (notifications on Android).
On Android, screens no longer slide under the status bar (clock, battery, notch) at the top or hide behind the navigation bar at the bottom.
The top-right menu now opens right over its button instead of spilling into the status bar.
Fixed the reciter picker showing an empty list.

Prayer times can now stay pinned at the top of the notification shade: a live countdown to the next prayer, and today's times when you pull it down (Android, turned on from the Prayer Times screen; the times can also be shown while collapsed). If you swipe it away it comes back within a minute.
The Prayer Times screen was redesigned: a big countdown, a progress bar between the two prayers, past times dimmed and the current one highlighted.
Location detection was fixed: places with Turkish letters like "İstanbul", "Karadeniz Ereğli" or "Şarkikaraağaç" now match the right district.
Added travel mode: when it is on and you move to another place, the times switch to the new location on their own.
Prayer times now show without internet once they have been downloaded.
Verse Shazam and Memorization Check are now in the Android app too: the speech model is downloaded once and recognition runs entirely on your phone.
The top-right menu now opens above everything on the page instead of hiding behind buttons or cards.

The Random Verse screen is simpler: the surah name and verse number sit above the verse, tapping the verse opens it in its surah, a clear "Show another verse" button sits at the bottom, and swiping to change the verse was removed.
Removed the description lines from page top bars and removed the welcome text from the home page.
The Memorization Check summary shows how many hints you used on each verse.
Memorization Check has a new "+1 hint" button: each tap reveals the next word of the verse.
Memorization Check has a new "Listen" button: the selected reciter reads just that verse and stops.
In Memorization Check, the misread letters of wrong words are now highlighted in yellow.
Memorization Check has a new surah and verse picker: choose the surah, then a single verse, a range of verses or the whole surah on one screen.
Memorization Check has a new sequential mode: recite the chosen verses in order, it moves on by itself after a flawless verse, and a summary shows how each verse went at the end.
Tapping a word-by-word translation now opens the word's Arabic root; "Search root" lists every verse that contains a word from that root. You can turn it off in settings.

While a verse plays, the letters of the word being recited are colored from right to left, words already recited stay colored, and a small triangle under the word follows the colored part (for the Sudais reciter); it can be turned off with "Word Tracking" under Settings > Audio Settings.
Arabic words on the surah page (reading view) are no longer stuck together; there is now a space between them.
Recently read verses are now also saved on your device, synced with your account, and a verse you read again moves to the top of the list.
A button at the bottom right of the home screen now shows the surah and verse you last read; tap it to continue where you left off.
Added a reciter (Qari) button to the top menu; change the reciter and listen to a preview without opening settings.
Prayer Times, Qibla Compass, My Duas and the Friday Sermon are now gathered in a new "Prayers and Duas" submenu.
In search results, the translation name now appears smaller, left-aligned below the verse heading.
The top-right menu no longer blocks scrolling while open; tapping outside it closes it.
Search by Topic results now show the verse in the translation where the match was found instead of your favorite one.
The Memorization Check screen now shows the speech model and WebGPU status.
Search by Topic results now tag each verse as "Strong match", "Related" or "Word match".

New "Search by Topic" screen (web): type a topic such as "patience" or "orphans' rights" and it finds related verses even when the word does not appear in them; it runs on your device and downloads a small model once. Search in the main menu is now a submenu offering "Classic Search" and "Search by Topic".

New "Memorization Check" screen (web): pick a surah and verse and recite it from memory; your recitation is checked and the correct words are marked green, while misread and skipped words are marked red.

New "Qibla Compass" screen: shows the direction and distance to the Kaaba from your location; opens from the Worship menu and the Umrah Guide. It warns you that the compass may not work properly when you are very close to the Kaaba.
In Verse Shazam, the words that were heard are highlighted in the verse found; for recitations spanning several verses, the heard part of each verse is shown separately.
Verse Shazam can now find a verse from an audio or video file (e.g. a recitation sent over WhatsApp).
New "Verse Shazam" screen (web): listens to a recitation through the microphone and finds the surah and verse; recognition runs on the device, with several speech models to download and choose from.
Added the sources and licenses of the speech models used by Verse Shazam to the About page.
When the graphics card can't be used (GPU access is off or running in software), Verse Shazam shows a guide for turning on hardware acceleration in Chrome.
Added Maher Al-Muaiqly to the reciter options.
Added a link to the app's source code on GitHub to the About page.
In paged view, the verse dots at the bottom are hidden while the player is open, leaving more room for reading.
Fixed a part claim getting lost when several people took different parts of a hatim at the same time.
Fixed quick successive settings changes sometimes being undone.
Translated the texts that stayed in Turkish in English mode on the share, go-to-verse, memorization, download and Hijri calendar screens.
Words that were missing from word-by-word translations (e.g. "اَلَمْ" in Al-Inshirah 1) now appear together with the word whose translation carries their meaning: "اَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ → açmadık mı?".
Autoplay moved from the top of the surah page into the player's mode button; choose "Single verse" to stop after each verse.
In paged view and on the Random Verse screen, the stop button on a playing verse now stops it instead of restarting it.
Fixed the screen briefly flashing white when opening the app with a dark theme.

The playback bar shown while a verse plays has been redesigned: modern icons instead of emojis, surah name and verse number shown, fits on one line; the mode and follow buttons briefly explain what they do when tapped.
On mobile, the top bar buttons (autoplay, font size, language, theme) no longer overflow: they're grouped under one button that slides down when tapped.
New reciter added: Yasser Ad-Dussary.
The whole app now uses one shared theme; cards, buttons and lists look the same on every screen.
Fixed some borders and the delete button showing the wrong colors in dark mode.
You can now share several consecutive verses in a single image; pick the last verse with "Verse Range" on the share screen.
Stop (waqf) marks now appear in verse images and on web reading with fonts that lack them (Aref Ruqaa, El Messiri, Markazi, Reem Kufi).
Words no longer run together in verse images and page view, and missing words now show up.
After changing theme, font or size in the image preview, downloading or sharing now uses the updated image.
The image preview now opens with the theme and size you chose on the share screen.
On phones, verse images now use your selected font and text size.

On web, you can turn a verse into a video (MP4) with your selected reciter's recitation, preview it, then download or share it; verses flow without gaps in the video. "Video with Recitation" is on both the share screen and the image preview.
Verse transitions are now seamless during continuous listening (autoplay, memorization, verse repeat, next surah); the next verse is loaded ahead and starts right on time.
Downloaded verse image and video file names no longer lose Turkish letters (e.g. "Insirah_Verse_5-6.mp4").
Videos with recitation are now always made with the audio format X, WhatsApp and Instagram accept (AAC), in every browser; fixes the "incompatible audio codec" error.
Fixed the Uzbek translation of Al-Fatiha appearing shifted by one verse; the updated data downloads automatically when you open the app (thanks 'kucukaslan').
Fixed an issue where your saved data (last read, dua list) could be reset when the app was opened on a weak connection.
General code maintenance and cleanup across the app (no visual change).
Replaced the outdated emoji icons on the verse share screen with modern icons.
Fixed an issue on the web version where the page could get stuck showing an old (cached) version after a new update was released.
Buttons across the app now share a single component for a more consistent look and feel.
Progress bars (Hatim screens, data update screen) now share a single component.
Added a Mushaf page view: read the Quran page by page following the standard 604-page layout, with page navigation.
The page view's top bar now has a control to increase or decrease the Arabic text size.
Added a translation picker to the page view: choose a translation (or word-by-word translation) to show below the verses.
Consolidated duplicated card styles across several screens (Profile, Forum, Dua Request, Hatim Detail).
Status labels (completed, locked, time remaining, etc.) now share a single component.
Loading screens (Home, Surah Detail, Random Verse, Hatim, Prayer Times, and others) now share a single component.
Search boxes (Home, Search, Prayer Times location picker) now share a single component.
Removed the redundant page number text from the page view's top bar; the surah name is now shown more prominently instead.
New setting: choose whether verse numbers are shown in Arabic digits (٣) or Latin digits (3).
Added the same Arabic text size control from the page view to the surah view.
The language selector is now fixed in the top bar on every screen; switch between Turkish and English with a single tap.
In lights-out theme, the top bar's green and the white text are slightly dimmed so they're easier on the eyes.
Fixed missing borders on the main menu cards and top bar buttons in lights-out theme.
Removed the search button from the Surahs screen; search and settings are now only accessible from the main menu.
The whole app UI is being moved into translation files (in progress).
Redesigned the main menu: a featured Surahs button and a clean, grouped list replace the colorful icon grid.
Fixed some surahs not being found in the surah search due to Turkish uppercase/lowercase İ/i mismatches (e.g. İsra).
Consolidated the surahs' English names, previously duplicated in a couple of places, into a single translation file.
Surah names (Turkish and English) now come entirely from translation files; the surah list, search and surah detail screen show the name in the active language.
Fixed a freeze/infinite-loop bug that could happen when switching theme in lights-out mode across screens.
Moved most of the app's interface text into translation files, including the Search, Random Verse, Profile, All Translations and Friday Sermon screens.
Fixed a Turkish uppercase/lowercase İ mismatch in the city/district search on the Prayer Times screen.
The Hatims list and hatim detail screens were fully moved into translation files.
The Dua List, Dua Request and Forum screens were fully moved into translation files.
The Umrah Guide, Where Am I Now, Umrah Duas and Umrah Checklist screens were fully moved into translation files.

Remaining text on the Surah Detail screen was moved into translation files too. App-wide UI text migration into translation files is now complete (the Hijri Calendar screen keeps its own dedicated Turkish/Arabic language toggle by design).
The flight/hotel/train action buttons on the Umrah Checklist screen now use the shared button component.
Menu rows on the main menu, Umrah Guide and Surahs list now use a shared component.

Cleaned up card, modal and badge styling in the Go to Verse, Image Preview, Share, Reciter Selector and Download Required components using shared styles; the Download Required screen's button now uses the shared button component.
Cleaned up card, badge, empty state and button styling on the Forum, All Translations, Prayer Times and Umrah screens using shared styles; some buttons now use the shared button component.
Cleaned up card, badge and text styling on the Settings and Hatim screens using shared styles; some buttons now use the shared button component.
Cleaned up text, badge and button styling on the Dua List, Dua Request, Profile, Random Verse and Search screens using shared styles; some buttons now use the shared button component.
About screen: added a language selector and a theme selector.
The theme selector is now fixed in the top bar on every screen; you can switch between light, dark and lights-out modes.
Rebuilt how settings, user data and forum data are fetched and updated; data now syncs more reliably.
In-app text is now managed from translation files (tr.json/en.json); the changelog moved here too.
Settings, bookmarks, my duas and forum data now stay available on-device even without an internet connection, and sync automatically once you're back online.
My Duas: fixed deleting a dua and rejecting a dua request.
Translation update: the download no longer failed to start when answering "No"; the update button is now hidden when data is already current.
PWA back button: the Android back button used to exit the app, it now navigates back within the app instead.
Font selection: added a separate Arabic font choice for Quran reading and for share images; font size can now be adjusted with A+/A- on the image preview screen.
Main menu: removed the settings icon from the top right.
Surah view: opening a verse from a bookmark now scrolls to the correct verse.
Hijri calendar: designed and added a calendar page (thanks MHS).
Main menu: switched to a grid layout.
Top bar: made the top menu smaller.
Uzbek translations: added new Uzbek (Cyrillic) and Uzbek (Latin) translations.
Translation data: translation files are now gzip-compressed, dropping the download from 80 MB to 20 MB (thanks 'kucukaslan').
Reciter removed: Minshawi Mujawwad was temporarily disabled due to recitation issues (thanks 'ssargin'). See video: https://youtu.be/dveu8DRo5Rk?si=oT3qaBZzKP8gydGG
Random verse page now shows the download screen when data is missing.
Search page now shows the download screen when data is missing.
Moved the download screen into a shared component.
Moved the download logic into a shared hook.
Search input is now normalized with fuzzy highlighting.
Fixed a rendering issue with the medli esre mark in Arabic text (thanks 'ferdogan').
Umrah support: added a "Where am I now?" screen to track tawaf and sa'y.
My Duas: added personal and on-behalf-of-others dua checklists.
Umrah duas: added a guide covering ihram, tawaf, sa'y and other umrah worship duas.
Checklist: added outbound/return flight info, a platform-aware date picker (web/mobile), and automatic Skyscanner integration.
PWA support: the web app can now be installed as a Progressive Web App and works offline.
New translations: added Kurdish (Kurmanji) Latin and Arabic-script Diyanet translations, plus the Ömer Çelik translation.
Data infrastructure: added version-based dynamic translation listing and a new processing engine for large data files.
Hatim page: added an interactive hatim system so users can complete a Quran reading together.
Prayer times: added location-aware prayer times covering every province and district in Turkey for 2025.
Friday sermon: added a dedicated section for reading the weekly Friday sermon as a PDF.
Location services: integrated GPS-based automatic location detection and manual city/district selection.
Added SQLite database support (Android/iOS)
Fast lookups via a composite (surah, verse) primary key
Transaction-based batch insert operations
Rebuilt the IndexedDB data structure - verses are now stored individually
Download progress bar now shows real-time byte counts
Added search to the surah list
Improved URL structure - the verse being read now shows in the URL
Updated the random verse and remove-favorite emojis
Fixed a bug with the remove-favorite button
Fixed AsyncStorage size limit issues
Performance improvements and memory optimization
Fixed scrolling on the random verse page
Fixed an audio preview bug
Shrunk the header and footer, removed the instruction text below
Added a "show all translations" button
Added sharing a verse with a different translation from the show-all-translations page
Added a home button to every page
Added different modes and sizes when generating share images
Added Google Analytics
Added verse sharing
Added sharing verses as images
Added dark mode verse sharing
Added a random verse page
Added a "verse by verse" option to memorization mode
Added audio preview when choosing a reciter
Added a dynamic page indicator in paginated view
Added a total verse count to the go-to-verse button
Fixed favorite translation support in the go-to-verse modal
Added release notes to the About screen
Added new reciters
Added a repeat count option to memorization mode
Audio player performance improvements
UI improvements and bug fixes

gpuHelp.step1: 1. Type the following into the address bar and set "Unsafe WebGPU Support" to Enabled:
gpuHelp.step2: 2. Type the following and set "Override software rendering list" to Enabled:
gpuHelp.step3: 3. Type the following and set "Vulkan" to Enabled. On Linux, Chrome reaches the graphics card through Vulkan; while it's off, WebGPU stays in software:
gpuHelp.relaunch: {{step}}. Restart Chrome with the "Relaunch" button at the bottom and come back to this page. If the WebGPU row in the status card shows your graphics card's name, the hardware is in use.
gpuHelp.note: These are experimental Chrome settings. Without them, Verse Shazam still works on the CPU (FastConformer).

kunutKadir.title: Qunut Dua
kunutKadir.description: The qunut recited on Laylat al-Qadr 2010 at the Al-Qaid Ibrahim Mosque in Alexandria: the qunut narrated by Hasan ibn Ali, with prayers for pardon and a farewell to Ramadan
parts: O Allah! Guide us among those You have guided, grant us well-being among those You have granted well-being, take us into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless us in what You have given, and protect us from the evil of what You have decreed.

For You decree and none decrees over You. Whoever You befriend is never humbled, and whoever You oppose is never honored. Blessed and exalted are You, our Lord. There is no refuge from You except in You.
O Allah! Forgive us what we did in earnest and in jest, by mistake and on purpose; all of that is in us.
O Allah! Make us ever remembering You, ever thankful to You, ever in awe of You, ever obedient to You, humble before You, and turning to You in earnest prayer and repentance.
O Allah! Accept our repentance, wash away our sin, answer our prayer, make our tongues speak what is right, and draw the resentment out of our chests. Remove rancor, hatred and envy from our hearts.
We disobeyed You and You gave us respite; we obeyed You and You rewarded us; and if we return to You, You accept us.
A generous Lord, an appreciative Lord, a forgiving Lord.

My Lord, how forbearing You are! My Lord, how merciful You are! My Lord, how merciful You are! My Lord, how forbearing You are! My Lord, how knowing You are! Our Lord! My Lord, how forbearing You are! My Lord, how merciful You are!
O Allah! You are pardoning and generous and You love to pardon, so pardon us.
Your pardon, O Pardoner, Your pardon! O Most Gracious, O Most Merciful, O Forbearing, Your pardon!
Your pardon in life, in death, in the grave, at the resurrection, when crossing the Sirat, at the Scale and at the reckoning. Your pardon, O Pardoner, O Forbearing!
Our God, our Creator and our Provider! If weeping is for something dear, then we are the most deserving to weep over Ramadan, O Lord of the worlds!
O Lord of Ramadan! Ramadan has gone, the days and nights have gone, and none is left for us but You. You are the Ever-Living who never dies.
O Allah! Do not deprive us of Your favor, Your bounty and Your generosity after Ramadan, O Lord of the worlds!
May Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad, his family and all his companions.
